en: Black‑and‑white historic postcard showing a large brick railway station complex with arched windows and a long glass‑roofed train shed. A clock tower rises near the center-right of the building. In the foreground is a cobblestone square with several men in late‑19th‑century or early‑20th‑century clothing standing or walking. A bridge or railing runs along the front of the station. At the bottom the caption reads "Centralstationen."
